a.lede: Apple's latest iOS 27.3 developer beta introduces a limited face unlock feature for the iPhone Duo, alongside other improvements.
a.title: Apple adds ‘face unlock’ to the iPhone Duo, but it’s not Face ID

b.lede: Not every version of iOS is a home run, but keeping your iPhone up to date is generally a good idea anyway. Here's how to check whether yours is.
b.title: How to check which iOS version your iPhone is running
